name: Li Qian
current_role: Chairman, Beijing Sun-Novo Pharmaceutical Research Co., Ltd. (STAR Market: 688621)
profile: Li Qian (利虔) is chairman and largest shareholder (~38%) of Beijing Sun-Novo Pharmaceutical Research, a CRO providing preclinical and clinical drug R&D services, which he has chaired since 2009. He also chairs Beijing Baiao Pharmaceuticals and is founder/executive director of Jiangsu Langyan Life Technology. Sun-Novo reported 2025 revenue of about RMB 1.22bn.
interesting_fact: Sun-Novo describes itself as moving from a pure CRO 'service provider' toward an innovation-driven 'partner' with its own self-developed drugs; 2025 revenue rose 12.9% to RMB 1.218bn and net profit 10.5% to RMB 196m.
deep_cut_fact: Besides Sun-Novo, he founded Jiangsu Langyan Life Technology Holdings (exec director since Jan 2016) and has been a non-executive director of Eastenova (Chengdu) Biotechnology since 2025; he studied at Peking University Health Science Center.
notes: Personally hosts investor meetings (e.g. March 2026) alongside IR director Guo Xinchi (郭心驰) and board secretary Wei Liping (魏丽萍); IR route is via SSE E-Interaction / company IR hotline. Company site sun-novo.com was unreachable during research.
